caption: The video captures a lone, leafless tree silhouetted on a low ridge that bisects the scene, under a star-filled sky fading from deep blue to a pale horizon glow. A calm water surface below mirrors the tree and sky in a near-symmetrical reflection. The tree, ridge, sky, and stars remain largely fixed, and the overall composition stays steady. The water shows faint, slowly changing ripples and bright glints that subtly distort the mirrored image, most noticeably along the lower branches of the reflection. A small bright spot appears in the reflected area, shifting slightly in position and intensity. The reflection remains present and aligned beneath the tree, mildly deformed by surface motion that has no clear start or finish.
